role_conditioning_primary_claim.criterion: At K=3, predicted-label minus label-blind mean > 0 and both seed-level t CI and hierarchical seed/document CI exclude zero positively.

blanket_superiority_over_bm25.criterion: Every protocol and K must pass the positive-effect gate against BM25.

k3_reranking_advantage_over_bm25.criterion: Protocol-specific K=3 positive-effect gate against BM25.

claim_decisions.manuscript_implication: Do not claim a reliable role-conditioning gain if the primary role gate is NO-GO; frame results around budget-dependent retrieval behavior and transparent cost/accuracy trade-offs.
